headline: Advisor Zahed ur Rahman calls Shakib Al Hasan a 'rotten person'
summary: The Prime Minister's Advisor on Information and Broadcasting says the government will ensure security for the cricketer if he returns to face cases.
details: Prime Minister's Advisor on Information and Broadcasting, Zahed ur Rahman, has described former national cricketer and former MP Shakib Al Hasan as a 'rotten person'.
Despite the harsh criticism, the Advisor stated that the government will ensure the necessary security for Shakib if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal proceedings.
The comments come amid ongoing legal cases and controversies surrounding the former all-rounder.
Zahed ur Rahman emphasized that the law will take its course, but the state's responsibility to provide security to those returning to face the law remains.
caption:
A 'rotten person'? Advisor Zahed ur Rahman doesn't hold back on Shakib Al Hasan.

Prime Minister's Advisor on Information and Broadcasting, Zahed ur Rahman, has described former national cricketer and former MP Shakib Al Hasan as a 'rotten person'.

Despite the harsh criticism, the Advisor stated that the government will ensure the necessary security for Shakib if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal proceedings.

The comments come amid ongoing legal cases and controversies surrounding the former all-rounder.

Zahed ur Rahman emphasized that the law will take its course, but the state's responsibility to provide security to those returning to face the law remains.

headline_marked: Actor [[Khairul Basar injured in Thailand]] during drama shoot
headline: Actor Khairul Basar injured in Thailand during drama shoot
summary: The actor and a cinematographer were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Koh Lan island while returning from a hill shoot.
details: Actor Khairul Basar and cinematographer Mehedi Rony were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Tuesday afternoon on Koh Lan island, Thailand.
The accident occurred around 4:30 PM Bangladesh time while the duo were descending a hill after completing a scene for a drama.
According to Basar, the scooter lost control during the descent, causing them to fall immediately.
Basar sustained injuries to his chest and knees, which have left him with difficulty walking.
The shooting team members who were nearby rescued the pair and transported them to a hospital in Pattaya for medical treatment.
Due to the physical condition of the actor, the production team has been forced to cancel the remainder of the shooting schedule.
caption:
A scooter accident on a Thai hill has left actor Khairul Basar seriously injured and unable to walk.

Actor Khairul Basar and cinematographer Mehedi Rony were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Tuesday afternoon on Koh Lan island, Thailand.

The accident occurred around 4:30 PM Bangladesh time while the duo were descending a hill after completing a scene for a drama.

According to Basar, the scooter lost control during the descent, causing them to fall immediately.

Basar sustained injuries to his chest and knees, which have left him with difficulty walking.

The shooting team members who were nearby rescued the pair and transported them to a hospital in Pattaya for medical treatment.

Due to the physical condition of the actor, the production team has been forced to cancel the remainder of the shooting schedule.
